description: A clock source, clock modulator and low-frequency oscillator with eight independently programmable outputs, set up from a touchscreen and an encoder rather than from knobs.

params.text: Turns to choose the highlighted item, move a value slider, or, with the menu switched off, set the tempo or the external clock mode
Confirms the highlighted item, ticks a checkbox, opens a value for editing, or enters the menu system
Leaves a value being edited, goes back one menu, and from the home menu switches the menu system off so the tempo can be changed

inputs.text: Takes the outside clock and makes the module follow it, or acts as CV1 when the menu has reassigned this jack; a pulse counts on the way up past 2V and the input rearms below 0.1V
Starts and stops the clock, as a held gate or as a toggling trigger, unless the menu has turned this jack into CV2
Resets the master phase and the phase of all eight outputs when the menu has made this jack RESET; otherwise it is the CV3 modulation input
A modulation input, bipolar -5V/+5V unless its own screen page has been set to unipolar 0V/+10V or bipolar -10V/+10V; assign it to a parameter of any output from that output's pages

outputs.text: Carries the output of that channel: a pulse, triangle, sine, sample and hold, envelope or wavetable at the ratio set for it, or the gate, start or stop utility voltage

notes: a new module has outputs 1 to 4 at ratio x1 and outputs 5 to 8 off with red LEDs. Patching a cable into an off output sets it to x1; otherwise left-click its LED and choose a Modifier
the input and output LEDs are buttons. A left click on one jumps the menu straight to that input's or that output's settings page.
with the CLK jack empty the module is its own master, running from 1 BPM, printed as 0.02Hz, to 500Hz; tempo reads in BPM to 900 BPM and in Hz above. Turn the encoder while the display is blue
with a cable in the CLK jack the module follows it by counted pulses, by one of thirteen PPQN settings from 2 to 192, or by a BPM-CV voltage; the encoder chooses which, with the menu off
a CV does nothing until it is assigned, and nothing is assigned on a new module; one parameter of one output takes a single CV source, so mix several sources outside the module
a jack set to carry the clock, or to run and stop the transport, is not a valid CV source, and the screen marks it with a red box or a blinking Not a CV message.
the touchscreen is one widget, so no part of the menu system can be clicked for help. Some of it takes a touch: the page arrows and the quantizer page's note rotations ignore the encoder
a left-side KX expander takes over the clock, run and reset duties and turns the first three jacks here into CV1, CV2 and CV3.
menu: CLK/CV1 input: External clock input (default), CV1 input (bipolar -5V/+5V), CV1 input (unipolar 0V/+10V) — sets what the first jack is for
RUN/CV2 input: RUN/STOP toggle (default), Run while hi-gate, CV2 input (bipolar -5V/+5V), CV2 input (unipolar 0V/+10V) — sets what the second jack is for
CV3/RESET input: CV3 input (default bipolar -5V/+5V), CV3 input (unipolar 0V/+10V), RESET input (pulse resets phases) — sets what the third jack is for
RUN input (KX expander): RUN/STOP toggle (default), Run while hi-gate — sets whether the expander's run jack toggles on a trigger or runs while a gate is held; it appears when a KX is attached
Prefer frequency (Hz) rather than BPM — shows and edits the master rate in Hz at any speed, which also lowers the slowest setting to 0.02Hz
Output 8: Master phase (M.PHASE) 0V/+10V ramp up @ tempo — sends the master phase as a rising ramp from output 8, keeping that output's settings until the option is switched off
